# DEZO

> Digital infrastructure, web development, technical SEO, and performance marketing agency in India.

## Core Capabilities

- [Commercial Services](https://dezo.in/services): Searchable catalog across Web Build, Technical SEO, Performance Marketing, Amazon & Flipkart Operations, and Business Automation.
- [Marketplace Hub](https://dezo.in/marketplace): Amazon and Flipkart seller growth, listing optimization, A+ content, and multi-channel telemetry.
- [Growth Lab](https://dezo.in/growth-lab): Free website and technical SEO scanner suite with instant diagnostic insights.
- [Industry Solutions](https://dezo.in/industries): Specialized digital growth frameworks for 16 key sectors across Odisha and India.
- [Regional Coverage](https://dezo.in/locations): Commercial hubs across Odisha including Bhubaneswar, Cuttack, Puri, Rourkela, and Sambalpur.
